title: Sequential localization commutes with slice restriction
statement: Let C be a small site with topology J and sheaf of commutative rings R [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For a:V→U and f in R(U), restriction along Over.map a identifies the module-sheaf O_U[1/f] with O_V[1/R(a)(f)], where both localizations are the sequential colimits [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-section-localization]. This is an isomorphism of modules over O_V.

source.place: Tag 0997; slice restriction as in sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 08JB.

proof.text: Restriction along Over.map a commutes with sheafification. Restrict its unit, extend by the slice sheafification adjunction, and show that this extension is an isomorphism: the restricted unit and slice unit are both locally injective and locally surjective. Covering sieves on an object over V are precisely the underlying covering sieves on its domain.

source.place: Tag 0997; slice restriction as in sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 08JB.

proof.text: Presheaf restriction preserves colimits by the sectionwise criterion. Sheafification preserves colimits as a left adjoint. The comparison of step 1 therefore shows that sheaf restriction preserves sequential colimits: first apply it to the presheaf diagram, then use the isomorphic sheafification counit to recover any sheaf diagram.

source.place: Tag 0997; slice restriction as in sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 08JB.

proof.text: The restricted unit module is the unit module, and multiplication by f becomes multiplication by R(a)(f), by functoriality of R. Construct the natural isomorphism of sequential diagrams using this equality. Colimit preservation and the induced colimit isomorphism give the claimed comparison, including f=0.

theorem ringedSite_localization_restriction
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (U V : C) (a : V ⟶ U)
    (f : R.obj.obj (op U)) :
    let R₀ := (sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R
    Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} R₀ a).obj
      (ringedSiteSectionLocalization R₀ U f) ≅
      ringedSiteSectionLocalization R₀ V (R.obj.map a.op f))
